heroHeadline: Senate Delegates Legislative Powers to Fujimori as Pope Leo XIV Visits Peru
heroSubtitle: President Keiko Fujimori, in office since 28 July 2026, won delegated legislative powers on security and El Niño after the Senate vote of 35–18 (21 Oct), following Deputies' 66–34 approval. Pope Leo XIV, former bishop of Chiclayo, visited Peru from 11 November.
footerNote: Data sourced from CVR Informe Final (2003), ONPE/JNE official results, BCRP, INEI, Inter-American Court of Human Rights, major Peruvian outlets (El Comercio, La República, Infobae Perú), and international news.
